questions.question: Where does Claude work in a session whose environment is Local?

options.text: On your own computer, in the folder chosen for the session
options.explanation: Correct. That’s why it’s worth choosing the folder carefully before the first message.

options.text: In the cloud, without touching your computer’s files
options.explanation: The cloud environment is a separate option. Local means your own computer.

options.text: On the whole computer, in every folder
options.explanation: Claude works in the folder you choose for the session.

questions.question: Claude has started doing something completely different from what you asked. What do you do?

options.text: I click the stop button or type a correction
options.explanation: Exactly. You can stop Claude or steer it in a new direction at any time.

options.text: I wait until it’s done and start everything over
options.explanation: There’s no need to wait. You can stop it right away or type a correction while it’s working.
That isn’t necessary. The stop button interrupts the work in a controlled way.
